method_notes: Schedule IDs and stats API season IDs are separate namespaces.
Confirmed regular-season schedule IDs are 1 (2022/23), 8 (2023/24), and 19 (2024/25).

For 2022/23–2023/24, 4,108 of 4,110 team sides matched; 4,107 of 4,108 matched validity flags agreed. Two unresolved discrepancies remain: DET–WAS on 2023-02-01 has no local game match, and BOS–CLE on 2023-12-12 has official BOS valid=true while the archive flag is false for both sides.

For 2024/25, 1,040 official records include 1,037 status=played, one status=playing that is present in the archive, and two status=postponed. The archive-backed set matches 2,076/2,076 team sides with 2,076/2,076 exact validity flags.

A read-only survey of candidate schedule IDs 1–60 and sampled matchday IDs 1–65 found NBA regular-season records only under schedule 1 (2022/23); a survey of sampled IDs 66–230 found NBA playoff records under schedule 3 but did not recover earlier NBA regular-season calendars for 2018/19–2021/22. This is not proof of nonexistence; those seasons remain unresolved.
Schedule ID 36 was identified by a sampled matchday in 2025/26; not fully audited against the local archive.
No raw data, official PDK targets, model, temporal splits, or backtests were modified.
